title: TablePredict
description: Build validated football table and World Cup group prediction links with TablePredict.
summary: Build validated football table and World Cup group prediction links with TablePredict.
offersHint: Build validated football table and World Cup group prediction links with TablePredict. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://tablepredict.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: tablepredict_list_competitions
toolsPreview.description: List competitions currently configured in TablePredict, including season, prediction mode, team count, cutoff, and predictor URL. Call this before requesting teams or building a prediction link. Returns no user data.

toolsPreview.name: tablepredict_get_competition_teams
toolsPreview.description: Return the exact canonical team names required to build a TablePredict link. Grouped competitions preserve their official group membership. Use an id, route slug, or display name from tablepredict_list_competitions.

toolsPreview.name: tablepredict_build_prediction_link
toolsPreview.description: Validate a complete prediction and return a source-attributed TablePredict URL prefilled with that ranking. Domestic competitions require order; grouped competitions require every group. This tool does not save, publish, or create an account.
